# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

Read [troubleshooting](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) and [documentation](../docs/README.md) before filing a reproducible GitHub Issue. Report vulnerabilities via [Security Policy](SECURITY.md), not public issues. Never expose tokens, private voice data or database credentials.

The repository contains self-hosted code, not a managed 24/7 API.
